text: SALES MIX BREAK EVEN POINT ANALYSIS Determine weighted average selling price: calculate total sales for all products and divide by total units sold Determine weighted average contribution margin: calculate total contribution margin for all products and divide by total units sold Calculate break-even point based on weighted average contribution margin (w.a. CM/w.a. selling price) To determine amount of each product to sell to break-even. Use the ratio of Product A sales units/total sales units and the ratio of Product B Sales units/by total sales.
